prompt:
I look after the network for Redstone Builders, a construction firm in Gwadar. We are redoing 2 sites, each with 2 area(s) and I need a clean design. Use one shared network per site. Give the PCs DHCP addresses. Use static routes between the sites. Bring in WAN internet behind an ASA 5506 firewall.

Also: Use an ASA 5506 as the edge firewall, with a public web server outside. Provide staff WiFi for laptops in the first area of each site. Include a DNS and HTTP server on the first site. The public server must be reachable from outside, but outside traffic must not initiate into the inside network.

Keep it practical and standard.
expected_behaviour: REFUSE-BY-NAME: a multi-site WAN star with an ASA at the first site is not a supported shape. The firewall replaces site1-r1, so the serial WAN has no first-site router and the expander refuses with 'wan-device-missing'. Offer a single-site ASA perimeter, or a multi-site WAN without the ASA.
why_valuable: Records a real matrix/engine mismatch: the certified cell medium-s2-a2-single-dhcp-wan-asa names a multi-site ASA shape the expander cannot place.
refusal_evidence: refusal: wan-device-missing: the serial WAN needs 'site1-r1', which was never created
